messages:
acme_prod_sre: Hey — noticed our org (org_8921) shows 0 monthly credits two hours before our tenant midnight. We had a long streaming socket overnight; got 429s this morning. Did the streaming session burn the monthly bucket early? We’re on America/Los_Angeles.
olivia_support: Sorry to hear that — can you confirm the org id (you already did, thx) and paste one example request_id or trace id from the 429s? Also are the 429s ‘rate_limited’ vs ‘quota_exhausted’?
acme_prod_sre: request_id 7f2b9c1a, error=quota_exhausted. We weren't spiking other traffic. The UI shows 0 tokens in the monthly bucket but we should've refilled at midnight PST.
raj_sre: quick note from infra: refill is scheduled based on tenant-local midnight, but the actual reconciliation pipeline runs on a UTC-windowed job. There's a known edge case where long-lived streaming connections that keep token leases open across midnight can cause the visible balance to be 0 until the ledger reconciliation completes.
maria_billing: to add: if you consumed burst/overdraft during the window the billing system may show the primary bucket as zero while a short reconciliation for burst credits runs — it usually corrects within minutes but I know that looks bad during demos.
acme_prod_sre: ok — is there a repro we can try on our side to confirm it's the same?
raj_sre: yes — repro we use locally:
```
# 1) open websocket/streaming session
# 2) continuously generate small messages for ~30-90m spanning tenant-local-midnight
# 3) keep connection alive for a few minutes after midnight so token lease closure occurs after refill job runs
# expected: UI or API read of remaining monthly bucket shows 0 until ledger sync.
```
olivia_support: If you want us to force a manual sync for org_8921 I can run an admin usage-sync that reconciles immediately (support-only endpoint). Workaround for customers: restart streaming socket after midnight or trigger a short, non-consuming call to force a local cache refresh.
acme_prod_sre: can you run that sync? we have a demo in ~20m.
olivia_support: Yep — pinging ops and running /admin/usage-sync now. @raj_sre is watching logs. :eyes:
quota_bot: Admin sync started for org_8921 by olivia_support at 2026-03-17T15:22:10Z.
raj_sre: I see the reconcile job pick up the org; ledger entries show ~45m of streaming that had token leases spanning the window. Sync applied reclaimed the correct tokens and UI should show the refill now.
maria_billing: FYI: if you prefer, we can apply a short-term credit top-up to avoid 429s during demos. Let me know org and amount.
acme_prod_sre: UI shows credits back, and 429s stopped. Huge help — thanks olivia and raj. We'll also add a restart step post-midnight to our runbook. :thumbsup:
olivia_support: Glad it helped — filing a short internal note so engineering can look at reducing the reconciliation window for streaming leases. If we see this repeatedly we can propose a small change to ledger flushing.
acme_prod_sre: appreciated, please keep us posted.
